rows.text: zeroes the qwords `[rcx]`, `[rcx+8]` and `[rcx+0x10]`; when `r8 - rdx` is nonzero it passes that length in `rdx` (with `rcx` unchanged) to the call at `002033C0` + 0x41, stores the result to `[rcx]` and `[rcx+8]` and the result plus the length to `[rcx+0x10]`, calls the import slot at `002033C0` + 0x64 with (the result, the incoming `rdx`, the length), and sets `[rcx+8]` to the result plus the length, returning that sum; when the length is zero it returns 0 with the three qwords left zero

when dword `rcx+0x7C` differs from `edx` it calls through the import slot `008C2430` with `ecx` = `r8d` and stops at `int3`; otherwise, when qword `[rcx]` differs from qword `rcx+0x10`, it checks the byte at `[rcx]` for 0x5C and, when the next byte's address is not qword `rcx+0x10` and either bit 3 (mask 8) of dword `rcx+0x80` is clear and that byte is 0x28 or 0x29, or bit 4 (mask 0x10) is clear and it is 0x7B or 0x7D, stores the next byte's address to `[rcx]`; it then increments qword `[rcx]` (on every path where it differed from `rcx+0x10`) and tail-jumps to `00209530` with `rcx` unchanged

returns `al` = 0 when the call at `002081A0` + 0x9 on `rcx` returns zero `al`; otherwise stores the sign-extended byte `rcx+0x78` to dword `rcx+0x74`, then, when qword `[rcx]` differs from qword `rcx+0x10`, checks the byte at `[rcx]` for 0x5C and, when the next byte's address is not qword `rcx+0x10` and either bit 3 (mask 8) of dword `rcx+0x80` is clear and that byte is 0x28 or 0x29, or bit 4 (mask 0x10) is clear and it is 0x7B or 0x7D, stores the next byte's address to `[rcx]`, and increments qword `[rcx]`; it then calls `00209530(rcx)` and returns `al` = 1

when dword `rcx+0x30` differs from `r8d`, `edx` is not negative and `r9d` is nonzero, it calls the site `002109F0` + 0x22 with qword `[rcx]` in `rcx` and `edx`, `r8d`, `r9d` passed through; on every path it then stores `r8d` to dword `rcx+0x30`

calls the site `00210A90` + 0x13 with qword `rcx+0x10` and `edx`; when that returns zero `al` it calls the site `00210A90` + 0x26 with qword `rcx+8` and `edx`; returns 1 when either call returned nonzero `al`, else 0
replaces `rcx` with qword `rcx+0x18`, zero-extends `r9b` into `r9d`, and tail-jumps at `00211220` + 0x8 with `edx` and `r8` passed through

walks the circular list whose head sits at `rcx+8`, following qword `+0x00` of each node until it is back at `rcx+8`; at the first node whose qword `+0x10` object has dword `+0x50` equal to `edx`, or at the first node at all when `edx` is -1, it tail-jumps at `00218E20` + 0x27 with that object in `rcx` and `edx` unchanged; returns with no call when the list is empty or no node matches
